title: The Jewish War — Book VI
creator: Flavius Josephus
date: ca. 75 CE work; Perseus English translation 1895
provenance: Perseus Digital Library edition of Josephus, Jewish War Book VI, preserving the account of the Temple fire and destruction.
notes: Near-contemporary first-century historical source by an author who states he was present during later phases of the war.
Josephus's proximity is valuable but does not make his interpretation, motives, or portrayal of Titus automatically neutral.
